lesson: Both trades failed due to premature entry against the dominant HTF bearish trend, as the system prioritized localized SMC liquidity sweeps over the broader Wyckoff distribution structure. The strategy is currently misinterpreting minor volatility as trend reversals, leading to stop-outs when the price fails to reclaim key resistance levels.
adjustment: Require a confirmed Market Structure Shift (MSS) on the 4H timeframe before executing any counter-trend or continuation setups on lower timeframes.
methodology_flag: Trust HTF Wyckoff structure more than 15m/30m SMC liquidity sweeps.
